g.text: Detailed inspection view: 174 inches wide with 30s minor ticks and 60s major ticks. Scroll horizontally to read individual intervals. Display rows are a visualization device used only to separate temporally overlapping recording files. They are not confirmed physical radio channels. Temporal overlap means only that two or more recording intervals cover the same wall-clock time. It does not establish on-air collision, stepped-on transmission, interruption, message loss, or channel saturation.
